stem: A genomic selection model was trained on a small, closely related population with inconsistent phenotype measurements. What is the main concern before applying it broadly?
choices: Prediction accuracy may not transfer because training population size, representation and phenotype quality are weak
More markers automatically remove phenotype error
The model no longer needs validation
Environment and genetic background cannot affect prediction
rationale: Genomic prediction depends on representative training populations, reliable phenotypes and validation in target germplasm/environments.
